mapper.select: SELECT TRANSPORT_ID, TYPE, DEPART_LOCATION, DESTINATION, DEPART_TIME, ARRIVE_TIME, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DEL_YN FROM TRANSPORT WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY TYPE, DEPART_TIME, TRANSPORT_ID
SELECT TRANSPORT_ID, TYPE, DEPART_LOCATION, DESTINATION, DEPART_TIME, ARRIVE_TIME, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, DEL_YN FROM TRANSPORT WHERE TRANSPORT_ID = #{transportId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRANSPORT ( TRANSPORT_ID, TYPE, DEPART_LOCATION, DESTINATION, DEPART_TIME, ARRIVE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{transportId}, #{type}, #{departLocation}, #{destination}, #{departTime}, #{arriveTime} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE TRANSPORT
TYPE = #{type}, DEPART_LOCATION = #{departLocation}, DESTINATION = #{destination}, DEPART_TIME = #{departTime}, ARRIVE_TIME = #{arriveTime}, UPDATED_AT = NOW()
WHERE TRANSPORT_ID = #{transportId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
UPDATE TRANSPORT SET DEL_YN = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE TRANSPORT_ID = #{transportId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
